name: app-mulish-typography-and-gradient-palette-sheet
title: Mulish Type and Gradient Palette Sheet
whatItIs: A design-system page with a large 'Mulish' specimen on a lavender card, a weight comparison showing a single 'a' revealed across four weights, and five tall gradient swatches with hex labels.
whatItMeans: Soft gradients and rounded cards keep the sheet gentle. The cropped weight reveal turns dry specs into a small visual moment.
techniques: Slice one letter across weight columns to show progression
Tall fading swatches with pin-like hex chips
Soft lavender glow inside the specimen card
Neutral off-white page around rounded cards

vocabulary.definition: A display of the same glyph in increasing weights.
A colour sample shown fading to transparent.
A small label giving a colour's hex code.
